cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Welcome to the swimming club! You're very welcome to watch until your induction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lovely. Can I join today's induction?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Absolutely, once you've observed one. Today you can watch from the gallery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The gallery's closed. Could I watch from the poolside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love to have you there. Poolside access requires induction, though. Let's find you a brochure with a lovely view.

mechanism: A kindly treats its former swimming pupil as ready for club progress while applying induction restrictions that ultimately replace observation with a brochure.
confusable: Not punitive exclusion: A keeps offering welcome and help while every alternative remains closed by the same rules.
comparison: House guest breakfast limits versus former learner blocked from club poolside.
